result.requirement: The system shall generate demand forecasts and resource plans to optimize agent positioning and store inventory levels based on predicted order volumes.
result.business_need: The business needs this to proactively allocate agents and stock before peak demand occurs, preventing service failures and reducing operational waste.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze historical patterns and current trends to predict future order volumes for specific zones and time windows.
The system shall recommend optimal positioning for Delivery Partners based on the predicted demand density.
The system shall suggest inventory replenishment levels for Store Partners based on anticipated item popularity.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect planned stock adjustments derived from the forecast.
The system shall validate that the predicted demand does not exceed the maximum capacity of the assigned Store Partner.
The system shall generate a resource plan document detailing the required agent count and stock levels for the forecasted period.
related_information_requirements: Predictive data regarding anticipated order volumes and item popularity for specific zones and time windows.
The current, validated quantity of each sellable item at a specific store location.
The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent.
Data indicating the status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale and the platform.
business_rules: The system shall only generate a resource plan if the predicted order volume exceeds the baseline threshold for the specific time window.
The system shall flag a Store Partner for immediate attention if the predicted demand exceeds 80% of their historical maximum capacity.
The system shall prioritize agent positioning recommendations for zones where predicted demand is rising faster than the average trend.
The system shall exclude Store Partners with a data link status indicating high latency or detected discrepancies from the resource plan.

acceptance_criteria.given: Historical order data and current trend indicators are available for a specific zone.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system runs the demand forecasting module for the upcoming time window.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a resource plan recommending specific agent positioning and inventory levels that align with the predicted volume.

acceptance_criteria.given: The predicted order volume for a specific Store Partner exceeds their maximum historical capacity.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the demand forecast for that partner.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the partner for immediate attention and adjusts the resource plan to suggest external support or order deferral.
